channel.title: NYCTrove — New York City guides
channel.description: NYCTrove is an independent New York City travel guide: curated itineraries, neighbourhood guides for all five boroughs, honest advice on passes and tickets, and practical tips from people who actually live here.

item.title: NYCTrove — The Independent Guide to New York City
item.description: Plan a better New York City trip: day-by-day itineraries, guides to all five boroughs, honest advice on passes and tickets, and the practical details that make the city easy.

item.title: 5 Days in NYC — The Complete First-Timer Itinerary
item.description: A five-day New York City itinerary for a first visit: the icons, museums, a full Brooklyn day and a proper night out — sequenced to minimise travel time.

item.title: New York City Attractions — Prices and Timing
item.description: The New York attractions worth planning around: observation deck prices, the Statue of Liberty ferry, museum admission, Broadway tickets and the order to book them in.

item.title: The Five Boroughs of New York City — A Local Guide
item.description: Guides to all five New York City boroughs: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Staten Island — what each is really like, what to do and where to eat.

item.title: Brooklyn Guide — DUMBO, Williamsburg & Park Slope
item.description: A local guide to Brooklyn: the Brooklyn Bridge walk, DUMBO, Williamsburg, Park Slope and Coney Island, plus where to eat and a one-day plan.

item.title: Day Trips from New York City Compared
item.description: Six day trips from New York compared: Philadelphia, Washington, Boston, Niagara Falls, the Hudson Valley and Atlantic City, with train times, fares and verdicts.

item.title: Where to Eat in New York City — Food Guide

item.title: New York City Itineraries — 3, 5 and 7 Day Plans
item.description: Day-by-day New York City itineraries for 3, 5 and 7 day trips: what to see, in what order, how long it takes and where to eat between stops.

item.title: Manhattan Guide — Sights, Areas and Where to Eat
item.description: A local guide to Manhattan: the neighbourhoods worth your time, the museums and skyline decks, where to eat, and a realistic one-day plan for the island.

item.title: New York Neighbourhoods to Walk and Eat In
item.description: Eight New York neighbourhoods worth planning a morning around, with what each is best for, how long to allow and the subway that gets you there.

item.title: NYC Passes Compared — CityPASS vs Go City

item.title: Plan Your Trip to New York City
